trap.label: ordem das palavras
trap.wrong: It was in the attic what she found it.
trap.right: It was in the attic that she found it.
trap.why: Português usa “foi… que/o que”; em inglês cleft usa that (ou who/where), nunca what.

opts: In attic was that she found.
It was in the attic what she found.
It was in the attic that she found it.

mcq.q: Which pseudo-cleft names what she wanted?
opts: What she wanted it was peace.

fix.wrong: It was yesterday when she called.
fix.right: It was yesterday that she called.

rewrite.prompt: Cleft: “She found it in the attic.”
rewrite.answer: It was in the attic that she found it.
